# Combat kit

`game.combat` reads attacks and armor, orders attacks, and makes explosions, fires and projectiles. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). Combat events (`projectile.hit`, `melee.hit`, `explosion.occurred`) are in the [event list](events.md).

```lua
-- Every ranged attack a colonist has
for _, v in ipairs(game.combat.verbs(colonist)) do
  if not v.melee then print(v.label, v.range, v.damage) end
end

-- A flare at the colonist's feet
local c = game.things.info(colonist)
game.combat.explode(game.maps.current(), c.x + 3, c.z, 2, { damage_def = "Flame", damage = 10 })
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.combat.verbs` | `thing` | `RimVerbInfo[]` | Attacks a pawn or weapon can make: range, burst, damage, melee or ranged. |
| `game.combat.attack` | `thing, target` | `boolean` | Orders a pawn to attack a target with its best verb. |
| `game.combat.armor` | `thing` | `RimArmor` | Armor rating against sharp, blunt and heat damage. |
| `game.combat.turret_info` | `thing` | `RimTurretInfo` | Target and state of a turret. |
| `game.combat.turret_target` | `thing, target?` | `boolean` | Orders a gun turret to attack a target, or clears the order when nil. |
| `game.combat.explode` | `map, x, z, radius, opts?` | `boolean` | Causes an explosion. |
| `game.combat.start_fire` | `map, x, z, size?` | `boolean` | Starts a fire on a cell. |
| `game.combat.extinguish` | `map, x, z` | `integer` | Puts out the fires on a cell. Returns how many. |
| `game.combat.fires` | `map` | `RimThing[]` | Every fire on the map. |
| `game.combat.launch` | `map, x, z, x2, z2, projectile, opts?` | `RimThing` | Launches a projectile def from one cell to another. |
| `game.combat.damage_defs` |  | `RimDamageDefInfo[]` | Every damage def. |
| `game.combat.projectile_defs` |  | `RimProjectileInfo[]` | Every projectile def with damage and speed. |
